notes: Variables, time and 15 min tolerance are from examples/05_data_assimilation/01_stormcast_sda.py:117,139,175-177 (StormCastCONUS run with SDA parameters).

The example builds its station list at run time with GHCNHourly.get_stations_bbox over the model domain (hundreds of stations); here 4 fixed central Oklahoma stations inside that domain are used, so timings understate the example's real fetch.
Cost scales with the station list, not the variable count: each station-year parquet is downloaded whole.
